name: Aino Nieminen
bio:
Aino Nieminen's motorsport journey began unexpectedly, fueled by a childhood fascination with rally racing videos smuggled in from her older brother. After studying mechanical engineering at Tampere University, she bypassed the typical engineering route, opting instead to immerse herself in the practical side of racing, volunteering with various Finnish rally teams. Her sharp eye for detail and uncanny ability to diagnose mechanical issues quickly caught the attention of Carlin Racing, who brought her on as a junior mechanic. 

 Rising through the ranks, Aino's pragmatic approach to problem-solving and her knack for identifying talent within the team led to her appointment as Team Principal. She prioritizes clear communication and data-driven decisions, fostering a collaborative environment where every team member feels empowered to contribute. Aino is fiercely protective of her team and known for her unwavering focus, even in the face of immense pressure, making her a respected, if somewhat intimidating, figure in the paddock.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, straight hair, often pulled back into a practical ponytail during races.
physical.description: Aino has a lean build and piercing blue eyes that convey both intelligence and determination.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn multi-tool in her pocket.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rhythmically against her notebook when deep in thought.
Insists on personally inspecting the tires before each race, regardless of weather conditions.
